args.summary: Commit a418ef67 (made 2026-11-04) changed fct_payments to join raw.branches directly instead of dim_branch. raw.branches keeps every weekly snapshot (14 per branch), so each payment matched 14 rows. That caused 3708 rows instead of 270, a failed unique payment_id test, a failed dbt_build so mart_delinquency was stale, and the volume alert. I reverted the commit (b88962f5) and rebuilt partition 2026-11-04: fct_payments now has 270 unique rows, mart_delinquency is current, and all alerts have cleared. Only 2026-11-04 was affected. The author's goal of removing the one-run region lag should be redone by joining the latest snapshot or deduplicating.
